Synopsis:
    South Korean President Lee Jae Myung is hosting the first South Korea-Central Asia multilateral summit in Seoul on 17 September 2026, preceded by bilateral meetings with leaders of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan (14–16 Sept). The agenda centres on trade, investment, energy, critical minerals and supply chains, framed under Seoul's New Northern Policy aimed at deepening Eurasian economic ties.
